analyst_view.overall: Bodø/Glimt are 25th of 36 with 4 points from 4 games, so this home game on the Aspmyra artificial pitch is close to a must-win to reach the play-off places; LASK are 16th with 6 points. Bodø arrive in good shape: they won 4-2 at Molde on Friday (two goals from Ole Didrik Blomberg) and are back top of the Eliteserien on 65 points, three clear of Viking, with KFUM Oslo next weekend, while Håkon Evjen and August Mikkelsen are still out and the numbers already count both. LASK have won five competitive games in a row, the latest 2-1 at home to Hartberg on Saturday, but centre-back Andrés Andrade limped off with an ankle injury after 21 minutes and, per Laola1 and Heute, has no diagnosis yet; George Bello (muscle) and Ramiz Harakaté (cruciate ligament) are out and already counted. No referee is named yet. The only change I make is a small nudge up on goals for Andrade's doubtful status.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.9 goals (2.7 Bodø, 1.1 LASK), already counting LASK's hot scoring run and the absences of Evjen, Mikkelsen, Bello and Harakaté. What they can't see is that LASK centre-back Andrés Andrade went off with an ankle injury on Saturday (two reports, no diagnosis yet), which could weaken the defence facing Bodø's strong home attack; as he is only doubtful I lean just a little higher, to about 4.0.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.4 corners, with Bodø taking more (5.9) as the side expected to have the ball and press at home. Both teams come in on winning runs and neither changes its usual style for this game; Andrade's possible absence matters more for goals than for corners, so I stay at about 10.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.4 cards, with LASK's recent low card count (-6.6%) already taken off. No referee is named yet and there is no rivalry here; a LASK side chasing the game in Bodø could foul more late on, but that is the normal picture for an away team, so I stay at 3.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 27 shots (14.5 Bodø, 12.5 LASK), already trimmed for Bodø's quieter recent shooting (-4%). Bodø's must-win situation and their four goals at Molde fit a busy home attack, which is what the numbers already expect, so I stay at 27.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.5 shots on target, already counting LASK's sharp recent finishing (+3.9%). Andrade's doubtful status is a small worry for LASK, but I have put that into goals and see nothing else the numbers miss, so I stay at 10.5.
